mainEntity.name: How do I choose between a wood-burning and a gas outdoor fireplace?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between wood-burning and gas depends on your priorities. Wood-burning fireplaces offer the authentic crackle, aroma, and larger flames of a traditional fire, but require firewood storage, ash cleanup, and adherence to local burn regulations. Gas fireplaces provide instant on/off convenience, consistent heat, and no ash or smoke, making them easier to maintain. However, they lack the sensory experience of a wood fire and require a gas line installation. Your preference for ambiance versus convenience, and local regulations, will guide your decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wood-burning offers authentic ambiance with more maintenance, while gas provides convenience with instant heat and less upkeep; choice depends on preference and local rules.
